title: Structured Treatment and Resource Efficiency Assessment With Lean Six Sigma Integration for Pulmonary Vein Isolation
official: Structured Treatment and Resource Efficiency Assessment With Lean Six Sigma Integration for Pulmonary Vein Isolation
summary:
The STREAMLINE-PVI trial is a prospective, single-center, randomized, open-label clinical trial comparing pulsed field ablation (PFA) with cryoballoon ablation (Cryo) for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in patients with atrial fibrillation (AF).

A total of 94 patients undergoing first-time PVI will be randomized 1:1 to either PFA or Cryo within standardized Lean Six Sigma (LSS)-optimized procedural workflows. The primary objective is to evaluate whether PFA reduces total procedure duration by at least 20% compared with Cryo without compromising safety or efficacy.

Secondary outcomes include post-procedural recovery, readiness for same-day discharge, atrial arrhythmia recurrence, AF burden, and procedural complications during a 12-month follow-up period.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* Willingness to participate and ability to provide informed consent
* Atrial fibrillation diagnosed within the past 2 years
* Scheduled for first-time pulmonary vein isolation (PVI)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation
* Reversible cause of atrial fibrillation (e.g., thyrotoxicosis, alcohol ingestion)
* Coexisting non-pulmonary vein-dependent atrial tachycardia
* Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (LVEF ≤40%)
* Indication for pacemaker or implantable cardioverter-defibrillator (ICD) implantation
* Severe mitral stenosis or regurgitation, or previous mitral valve repair or replacement
* Known intracardiac thrombus formation despite continuous oral anticoagulation for more than 4 weeks
* Incessant ventricular tachycardia
* Surgical coronary revascularization within the previous 30 days
* Myocardial infarction within the previous 30 days
* Ongoing triple antithrombotic therapy following percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI)
* Contraindication to contrast media
* Contraindication to oral anticoagulation
* Body mass index (BMI) \>35 kg/m²
* Inability to provide written informed consent
* Life expectancy \<12 months
